company_description: Sofina Société Anonyme is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in direct and fund of funds investments. Within direct investments, it specializes in growth capital, early, startup, later stages, mature, emerging growth, mid venture, late venture and LBO investments. The firm primarily invests in portfolio of companies that engages in digital transformation, consumer & retail, education, healthcare, life sciences, sustainable supply chains, energy and services, e-commerce, consumer goods, digital, satellite operations, industry, finance companies, and financial services worldwide. It also invests in the media, communications, insurance, property development sectors. The firm typically invests in European based companies with a global exposure, and it also has a particular focus on companies based in Western Europe and Asia such as in India, China and Southeast Asia and in the United States. It invests in minority investments between 100 million ($103.08 million) and 300 million ($309.25 million). risks.title: Investment Selection and Monitoring Risk
risks.summary: Risk that the investment process is flawed, leading to poor-quality selection of holdings or inadequate post-investment monitoring. Sofina primarily invests as a minority shareholder in diversified companies (Europe, United States, Asia); poor data analysis or strategic misalignment compromises long-term value creation.
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked #7 in the matrix (investment process) with medium-high impact/probability. Specific language: 'investment misalignment with strategic objectives, poor data analysis.' Sofina critically depends on the quality of its selection and monitoring process to create value.

risks.title: Untimely or Non-Compliant Divestment Risk
risks.summary: Risk of not exiting an investment at the optimal time, resulting in losses or opportunity costs. Also includes legal and regulatory risk if the exit does not comply with applicable laws in the various jurisdictions where Sofina operates.
risks.score_rationale: Risk #8 in the matrix (divestment process) with medium impact. Explicit language: 'failing to divest at an opportune time resulting in a loss or opportunity cost' and 'exit without complying with laws and regulations.' Sofina deepened this risk assessment in 2018.

risks.title: Divergence of Interests with Minority Shareholders Risk
risks.summary: As a minority investor in its holdings, Sofina faces the risk that its interests or strategic vision may diverge from those of the majority shareholder, limiting its influence over the holding's operational and strategic decisions.
risks.score_rationale: Risk #11 in the matrix (minority) with medium impact. Sofina primarily invests as a minority shareholder; its rights or vision may diverge from those of the majority shareholder. Structural risk inherent to the investment model.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT Infrastructure Risk
risks.summary: Cyber threats constitute a major operational risk for Sofina. IT tools and infrastructure must adequately meet the Company's needs; any inadequacy or security breach could compromise sensitive investment data, valuation processes, and operational continuity.
risks.score_rationale: Risk #22 in the matrix (cybersecurity and IT) classified as an internal audit priority in 2019. Intensive language: 'cyber threats constitute a major operational risk.' Sofina launched Office 365 deployments and is strengthening objectivity through Duff & Phelps. Upward trend with geographic and sector expansion.

risks.title: Key Person Loss and Talent Management Risk
risks.summary: Risk that key individuals leave Sofina or that the Company cannot recruit the talent needed to execute its strategy. Given Sofina's small size and its sector/geographic expansion, talent retention and human capital development are critical to achieving growth objectives.
risks.score_rationale: Risk #23 in the matrix (loss of key individuals) deepened in 2018. Explicit language: 'Sofina must recruit, retain, and develop its human capital.' Sofina is a small organization (limited staff); loss of critical talent directly impacts strategy and execution capability.

risks.title: Regulatory and Legal Non-Compliance Risk
risks.summary: Risk of non-compliance with applicable laws and regulations (through action or omission, intentional or not) in the multiple jurisdictions where Sofina operates. Also includes risk of not sufficiently anticipating the impact of legislative/regulatory framework changes (GDPR, SRDII, Code 2020) on its investment and governance activities.
risks.score_rationale: Risks #28, #30, #31 in the matrix (legal compliance, anticipating legislative framework, regulatory evolution). Specific language: 'risk of non-compliance through action or omission.' GDPR deepened in 2019. Sofina operates in a constantly evolving regulatory environment (Europe, United States, Asia).

risks.title: Portfolio Diversification or Non-Qualitative Selection Risk
risks.summary: Risk related to insufficient portfolio diversification or systematically poor-quality selection of holdings. Excessive concentration in certain sectors, geographies, or investment styles could amplify exposure to economic or sector shocks.
risks.score_rationale: Risk #5 in the matrix (portfolio) with medium impact. Language: 'lack of diversification or systematically non-qualitative selection.' Sofina aims to maintain portfolio diversification; excessive concentration or flawed selection concentrates risks.

risks.title: Reputation and Third-Party Actions/Inactions Risk
risks.summary: Legal and reputational risk arising directly or indirectly from Sofina's activities or those of its holdings. Actions or inactions by third parties (particularly portfolio companies) may affect Sofina's reputation and generate legal or financial consequences.
risks.score_rationale: Risks #4 and #32 in the matrix (reputation, third-party actions/inactions). Language: 'legal and reputational risk that Sofina incurs due to actions or inactions of third parties (mainly portfolio companies).' Sofina deepened this risk assessment in 2018.
